channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: River North Mass Shooting Kills 1, Wounds 3 Others, Police Say
item.description: Four men were entering a Lamborghini when a group of men walked up to them and opened fire, according to police and media reports.

item.title: 3 Wounded In Shooting Near St. Sabina Church After Adult Basketball Game
item.description: Three men in their 30s were taken to local hospitals, where their conditions stabilized, police said. "You expect that people that age have a little more sense and a little more wisdom than this kind of craziness,” said the Rev. Michael Pfleger.

item.title: The Radicle, A Seafood Spot From Daisies Team, Opens In Logan Square With NYE Party
item.description: Like Daisies, The Radicle is rooted in the flavors of the Great Lakes region and shaped by partnerships with local growers.

item.title: Why Block Club Wrote ‘Chicago Under Siege’
item.description: To investigate what happened during Midway Blitz, our reporters spoke to more than 60 people, pored over notes and reconnected with eyewitnesses while digging for new ones. They watched and analyzed 50 hours of video. They reviewed hundreds of pages of records and court documents.

item.title: An Immigrant Reporter On Documenting ICE In Chicago: ‘Truth Matters’
item.description: For Block Club reporter Francia García Hernández, covering Operation Midway Blitz brought her own fears — and a resolve — to the forefront. "I am exactly where I’m supposed to be — telling the truth."

item.title: Chicago’s ‘Quantum Prairie’ Promises New Era Of Great Lakes Technology And Water Use
item.description: Big technology development aims for zero water waste.

item.title: Chicago Sets 10 PM New Year’s Eve Curfew For Minors After Area Shootings
item.description: “We’re asking parents who may not be as diligent as most parents already are, to just know where their children are,” Mayor Brandon Johnson said.

item.title: Chicago Under Siege: How Operation Midway Blitz Changed Our City
item.description: Federal agents arrested thousands during an unprecedented immigration mission in Chicago. They also killed a man, shot a woman five times, tear-gassed a 1-year-old, separated families and brutalized people across the city, claiming it was all to make Chicago safe.

item.title: Chicago To Ring In New Year With Lake-Effect Snow And Cold Temps
item.description: Two “clipper systems” are expected to move across the Chicago area over the next two days, bringing a dusting of snow and slippery roads.

item.title: ‘Abolish ICE’ Snowplow Name Gets National Attention — And The Mayor’s Support
item.description: The Chicagoan who submitted the name has done so several times over the years, but thinks this could be the year it wins. "As a fourth-generation Mexican American, I am incredibly heartened by the response and support," he said.
